rules: No visual change: every proposed token carries the identical value of the literal it replaces.

A literal maps to a scale token only when it equals that step at standard density. Density-aware tokens (--spacing-stack etc.) are never used for a literal that does not already follow density, because compact and comfortable would change pixels. Those literals map to the density-invariant --spacing-fixed-* twin.
A literal that matches no step is minted as an --*-off-<value> token with the same value. Nothing is snapped.
Colour drift stays as separate named tokens (--color-icon-*, --color-stage-*, instrument tier) and is listed in drift[] for the owner.
locked: instrument and chrome tiers (derived from Prism override)

rebrand.mechanismToday: apps/example/brands/*.json carries identity only; tooling/brand/brand.schema.json has additionalProperties:false; Prism colours come from the hand-written prismThemes override in theme.ts
checks: text and textMuted on surfaceRaised and surfaceSunken >= 4.5:1
computed with contrastRatio and luminance from forge-directions.ts
